svg.aria-label: Cybersecurity: recon, networking, CTFs and hardening, practice on HackTheBox, Root-Me and Isontopia. SDR: capture and decode signals. OSINT: verified public sources. Forensics: disk, memory and artifacts. Cryptography: how it works and how it fails. Low level: Rust and Go today, assembly and reverse engineering next.
